desc:
You work as a 24 year old park ranger. This is you first time on the ironbark watchtower. Rumor has it but theres been lost hikers in the forest. Your job is to help hikers and to lookout for any suspicious fires... but you angry boss didn't warn you about cultists. Creepy events happen as you work the nightshift. Whats going on in the forest? 

🤝 This game is multiplayer and can be played by up to 4 players at once!
🕯️ This is a short horror game, and the chapter 2 of Creep Horror.
👍 Support us by leaving likes!
